content.text: What This Actually Is and Why It Matters: Notion templates

Selling digital products like Notion templates for crypto requires a commerce stack that can process payments without relying on Stripe or other blocked platforms. This is where sovereign digital commerce infrastructure comes in – a set of free and paid tools that give you a fully operational online store with automatic crypto payment processing, instant product delivery, and full data ownership. With this infrastructure, you can sell your templates without giving up control or paying platform fees.
How the Architecture Works Under the Hood

The architecture works by combining GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages for hosting, Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script for backend logic, Supabase or Google Sheets for order storage, and Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 for file delivery. NOWPayments provides automatic on-chain crypto payment verification with a 0.5% fee only. This setup allows you to deploy a sovereign digital commerce stack in just 48 hours, giving you a fully operational online store with no reliance on Stripe or similar platforms.
Who This Is Built For and Why

This infrastructure is built for digital creators in regions where Stripe, PayPal, Gumroad, or other platforms are unavailable or severely restricted. These creators sell digital products like ebooks, courses, templates, fonts, presets, beats, plugins, and software, but they need a way to process payments without relying on blocked platforms.
